title: Nvidia RTX Spark devices are now officially on sale, secure the Surface Laptop Ultra or other RTX Spark laptops here
text:
Nvidia's RTX Spark is now generally available for immediate shipment at multiple retailers. Orders for RTX Spark from brands like Asus, Microsoft, Lenovo, HP, and Dell are live now, including the new Surface Laptop Ultra. Additional devices will be available post-launch, including small form factor desktops. Further below, you'll find the full list of all available models in detail, but we also have more general links here:
Order RTX Spark devices at Best Buy
Order RTX Spark devices at B&H
Order Surface Laptop Ultra at Microsoft
Best Buy has a limited lineup of devices to start, ranging from the Asus ProArt P14 with 24GB of memory for $2,599 up to the Surface Laptop Ultra with 48GB of memory for $3,999. If you want to scale up the RTX Spark's maximum of 128GB of memory, you'll need to shop elsewhere.
Nvidia RTX Spark 128GB and 64GB laptop orders
ProArt P16 RTX Spark: $4399.99
The Asus ProArt P16 is a 16-inch laptop with the RTX Spark chip, which includes the 20-core Grace CPU and a Blackwell GPU, along with up to 128GB of unified memory. View Deal
Asus has the ProArt P16 available with either 64GB or 128GB of unified memory directly from its web store, starting at $4,499.99 for the 64GB configuration. If you upgrade to 128GB of unified memory, the laptop comes in at $6,999.99 with 2TB of storage.
Lenovo Pro 9n Nvidia: $2999.99
The Lenovo Pro 9n comes with the 18-core N1X processor paired with 32GB of LPDDR5X-9400 and a 15.3-inch 2560x1600 OLED panel that runs at a blistering 165Hz.View Deal
The HP OmniBook X 14 is a 14-inch laptop with the RTX Spark chip. It includes a 3K OLED touch display at a 120Hz refresh rate, along with up to 128GB of unified memory. View Deal
The HP OmniBook Ultra 16 is a 16-inch laptop with the RTX Spark chip and supports up to 128GB of unified memory. View Deal
HP has two models available directly in its web store, both of which support up to 128GB of unified memory (along with 64GB, 48GB, 32GB, and 24GB). Both models are significantly cheaper than the ProArt P16 with 128GB of unified memory. The OmniBook X comes in at $5,109, while the OmniBook Ultra runs $5,309, both with 1TB of storage.
The two models are very similar, differing primarily in screen size. The OmniBook X is 14 inches, and the OmniBook Ultra is 16 inches. Both come with a 3K OLED touch display with a 120Hz refresh rate, and they support up to 2TB of storage.
With both laptops, you'll get a smaller 5120-core GPU with the 32GB configuration. With all other configurations, you get the full 6,144-core GPU available on the RTX Spark.
The Surface Laptop Ultra is a 15-inch laptop with the RTX Spark chip and up to 128GB of unified memory. View Deal
Finally, the Surface Laptop Ultra is available up to 128GB directly from Microsoft. It's also available from B&H, though it appears configurations with more memory capacity are exclusive to first-party sources right now.
Nvidia RTX Spark Best Buy Orders
Best Buy has a broad range of RTX Spark laptops available for order, topping out at 64GB of unified memory. All of the devices through Best Buy are expected to ship on the October 16 release date. You can find all of the orders going on right below.
We've included the starting configuration for each machine, though note that Best Buy has other configurations of these models available for order as well. You can browse all of the orders directly on Best Buy.
ProArt P14 (RTX Spark): $2599.99
The Asus ProArt P14 is a 14-inch laptop with Nvidia's RTX Spark chip. View Deal
The Prestige N16 Flip features a 16-inch 120Hz OLED panel and 32GB of LPDDR5X memory. View Deal
Surface Laptop Ultra (RTX Spark): $2599.99
The Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra features Nvidia's RTX Spark chip and up to 128GB of unified memory. View Deal
ProArt P16 (RTX Spark): $2799.99
The Asus ProArt P16 is a 16-inch laptop with up to 128GB of unified memory and 2TB of storage, featuring the RTX Spark chip. View Deal
OmniBook Ultra (RTX Spark): $3199.99
The HP OmniBook Ultra is a 16-inch laptop with the RTX Spark chip and 3K OLED touch display. View Deal
XPS 16 (RTX Spark): $3799.99
The Dell XPS 16 is a 16-inch laptop from Dell's premium XPS line, sporting the RTX Spark chip. View Deal
Yoga 9n 2-In-1 (RTX Spark): $3099.99
The Lenovo Yoga 9n is a convertible 2-in-1 laptop that features Nvidia's RTX Spark chip. View Deal
Nvidia RTX Spark specs to know before ordering
Nvidia calls its latest SoC simply "RTX Spark," but it's actually a range with two different chips. The full chip comes with a 20-core Grace CPU and 6144-core Blackwell GPU, but there's a lower-end configuration with an 18-core Grace CPU and 5120-core Blackwell GPU.
Pay close attention to which you are ordering. Listings will simply call the chip "RTX Spark N1X," and you have to read through the description to confirm the core counts on the CPU and GPU.
From the orders available now, we've only seen the 18-core CPU/5120-core GPU version with laptops that have 24GB or 32GB of Unified Memory. Listings with 48GB or above have the full chip. The RTX Spark is available with several different memory capacities, including 24GB, 32GB, 48GB, 64GB, and 128GB.
For storage, we've seen configurations with 512GB, 1TB, and 2TB, though the vast majority of devices top out at 1TB, including the Surface Laptop Ultra. Undoubtedly, we'll see configurations with more storage capacity eventually, but that's a tough sell right now when even a tricked-out 2TB configuration costs $7,000.
